corrections.text: The article states the merged pull request '#155499' touched '428 files, adding roughly 1,800 lines and removing roughly 3,600.' No diff-stat figures of any kind (file count, additions, or deletions) appear in the cited PR page as captured in our source snapshot — GitHub loads that information via a separate request not included in the archived page. This claim could not be verified against the cited source and should be treated as unconfirmed.

The article describes the person who reported issue #161841 as 'A Google engineer working on Fuchsia.' The cited GitHub issue identifies the reporter only by username ('ilovepi') and name ('Paul Kirth') and by their work 'qualifying a new toolchain for Fuchsia'; no employer or company affiliation appears anywhere on the page. The 'Google engineer' characterization is not supported by the cited source.
